system.description:
CHANCE FOCUS RHEVANI

You know your own soul too well to surrender it easily.
Action R; Trigger You fail a saving throw against possession or a Mental effect that would alter, erase or suppress your memories, personality or identity.
Reroll the triggering saving throw with Advantage and use the better result. Continuity Unbroken is then expended and must be restored using Refocus.

Prerequisites Level 10

Use as the Reaction (Focus): spends the use and the reaction; reroll the failed save with advantage from your sheet.
